title: What is Exception Handling?
overview: Exception handling is a way to manage runtime errors in a program without stopping its execution. Python uses try and except blocks to handle errors.

title: try and except Block
overview: The try block contains code that may cause an error, while the except block handles the error when it occurs.

example.title: try except Example

title: Handling Specific Exceptions
overview: Python allows handling specific types of errors instead of catching all exceptions. This makes error handling more accurate.

example.title: Specific Exception Example

title: finally and else Blocks
overview: The finally block always executes, while the else block runs only when no exception occurs.

example.title: finally Example

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Python handles errors using try, except, else, and finally blocks to create safer applications.
